posts.en:
awesome-dsh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f299b2db46fec6deb6fd.html
